# Save Our Solar Club

> Residential solar maintenance, repair coordination, monitoring, and dispatch support through a nationwide network of solar professionals.

Save Our Solar Club is operated by SaveOurSolar LTD. Its listed office is 7535 East Hampden Avenue, Suite 400, Denver, CO 80231. Phone: (970) 601-7369. Email: Sos@saveoursolarclub.com.

The company describes a nationwide network. City pages describe service inquiries and homeowner guidance, not local branch offices. Address coverage, technician availability, compatible equipment, costs, and visit timing are confirmed by the team. A 24/7 dispatch line is not a guarantee of a same-day on-site visit. Membership terms and fees are on the current membership page.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/): Company overview.
- [Services](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/services): Current maintenance, repairs, monitoring, roofing, and detach/reset offerings.
- [Membership](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/membership): Current plans, pricing, and terms to review with the team.
- [Insurance](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/insurance): Storm and loss-damage inspection and claim support.
- [Insights](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/insights): Homeowner guides on solar maintenance and repairs.
- [Contact](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/contact): Inspection and service inquiries.
- [About](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/about): Company and network information.

## Service areas

- [National directory](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/service-areas/): Browse 348 city guides across all 50 states and Washington, D.C.
- [City page index](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/service-areas/llms.txt): Links to every city guide.
- [Plain-text directory](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/service-areas/index.md): Readable directory content.
- [Service-area sitemap](https://www.saveoursolarclub.com/sitemaps/service-areas.xml): Canonical national, state, and city URLs.

City pages have matching index.md versions. These mirrors contain the same homeowner guidance and are supplementary to the HTML pages.

## Local solar data

City guides include NASA POWER 2001–2020 regional solar climatology for the 1° grid containing each city’s Census representative point. Values are sunlight on a horizontal surface, in kWh/m²/day. They are not actual electricity production, rooftop measurements, current weather, savings projections, or guarantees. Nearby cities may share a regional grid. Government resource links do not imply endorsement or affiliation.
